adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a `raw_html` cook method that bypasses the normal cooking/rendering pipeline: `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts from remote/feed content with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), where `contents` comes from RSS (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) or remote fetch. There is no sanitizer applied in this path, and the embed view renders with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), meaning any `<script>` or event-handler HTML from a feed item could execute in viewers’ browsers under the forum origin.
